_comment: call.subscribe's replay and once (TypeScript { replay, once }, Python replay=, once=, Go wakeshift.Replay, wakeshift.Once) and what they add to POST /event-subscriptions: replay in seconds (each SDK's duration as a number), once as true, nothing when left out. Shared by the three SDKs.
_context_comment: context (TypeScript { context }, Python context=, Go wakeshift.Context(v)) is the app's own value for the event's onSubscribe (Subscribed.context): it never reaches Wakeshift, so it adds nothing to the body, and context-canary appears in no request and no log line.
_next_comment: Next release (design §2.5, CR L8, PR 6). replay_bounds: 0 < replay <= 24 hours, checked before sending with the same error in every SDK: UsageError, code bad_arguments, the message containing says; Wakeshift isn't asked. A case with body is accepted and adds that body, as cases does. replay_seconds is the duration in seconds: TypeScript passes it as a number (seconds, as today) or as the Duration string in replay_string where one is given; Python as an int or float of seconds, a timedelta, or replay_string; Go as time.Duration. Run each case through every form the SDK accepts. duration_strings: the Duration strings TypeScript and Python accept (a number, then s, m, h or d) and the seconds each sends; a string with want_error is refused the same way. Renewal (the same arguments again) applies replay only on creation (CR L9): not checked here.
